nodes.label: Fried Chicken Sandwich with Asian Slaw
nodes.description: A large, indulgent crispy fried chicken sandwich served on a wooden cutting board. Features a thick golden-fried chicken breast glazed with a sweet and spicy Asian-inspired sauce (likely gochujang), topped with a colorful slaw of shredded carrots, cabbage, and bean sprouts, all in a toasted brioche bun. Sauce drips dramatically down the sides. A blue ceramic bowl with a side dish is visible in the background. Vibrant abstract mural art adorns the restaurant wall, conveying upscale casual dining with Asian-fusion culinary identity.
nodes.presentation: Rustic-upscale, served on wooden cutting board with dramatic sauce drip, garnished with green onion
nodes.purpose: Menu hero image — showcases signature sandwich item to attract customers and convey the restaurant's Asian-fusion identity
